regions.title: Construct a total measurable finite-history interpolation
regions.formula: \Psi_n(h)(s)=\Phi_{s-a_j}(z_j),\quad j=\max\{i\le n:h_i=\operatorname{live}(a_i,z_i),\ a_i\le s\},\quad\text{if this set is nonempty; otherwise }\Psi_n(h)(s)=z_0.
regions.exposition: Fix one coordinate s of the path. Each tagged record either retains the accumulator or replaces it by the harmonic flow at s−a; the live/stopped tag and a≤s are Borel. Finite induction proves the fold measurable. The product sigma algebra then makes the entire function-valued map measurable by its coordinates. The last eligible record controls the fold, including when no record is eligible and z₀ remains. Reuse the actual harmonic-flow joint measurability to obtain Ψ for every parameter and arbitrary history.

regions.title: Convert conditional next-wait survival into a weighted history measure
regions.exposition: The actual conditional survival theorem applies at the history-dependent residual d=max(T−lastTime,0). For every Borel history event A, its probability with survival is the history integral of W over A. Apply this to B∩A for an arbitrary Borel test set B; measure extensionality identifies H_*(P|_{H∈A,survival})=(H_*P|_A).withDensity(W). Measurability is inherited from actual history, the tagged time observer and the actual hazard. No positive conditioning probability or finite wait is required, and W vanishes on the stopped tag.

regions.title: Attach the terminal factor to the ordered-prefix law
regions.exposition: Apply the weighted history identity to F(h,Ψ(h)). The actual ordered-prefix law applies to this nonnegative measurable function times W, giving the simplex integral of F(K,Ψ(K))qW. This is precisely F(K,Γ)ρ. Joint measurability of K, Ψ, q and the tagged terminal weight implies joint measurability of Γ and ρ for the stated sigma algebras. Equality of all nonnegative tests gives the joint history/interpolation pushforward, and F=1 gives its unnormalized mass P(C_n)≤1. This step does not yet identify C_n with a count event.

regions.title: Identify interpolation with one actual process on the raw event
regions.exposition: Take the existing jointly measurable physical-time representative Z, with its exact covered-arc and uncovered-fallback behavior. On C_n all records through n are live, and strict terminal survival gives T<T_(n+1), also when the wait is infinite. At any s≤T choose the greatest index j≤n whose record time is at most s; initialization supplies index0. Every later index is ineligible and the next event lies after s. The finite fold therefore equals the harmonic arc selected by the actual Z. Function extensionality gives whole-path equality on every raw C_n sample, without assuming a measurable diagonal in the uncountable path space.

regions.title: Make the total count measurable and relate interval indices to cardinalities
regions.exposition: Each half-open interval membership predicate is Borel because actual event times are jointly measurable. Their countable union is Borel. On that union the least successful index is measurable; use0 off it. Distinct half-open intervals cannot overlap for a monotone event-time sequence. If N selects the covering interval, monotonicity gives T_j≤T iff j≤N. In the absence of positive-index events exactly at T the strict and non-strict positive-index sets both equal {1,…,N}, hence are finite with cardinality N. The no-atom condition is an internal dependency supplied below.

regions.title: Read the prescribed path at its last eligible event
regions.exposition: Every ordered simplex time is nonnegative. The real time and nonnegative-time coercions therefore agree, and the last-eligible fold identity yields Γ(t)(s)=Φ_(s−s_j)(z_j). The condition requires s_j≤s and all later s_k>s; at an event time the selected state is the post-bounce z_j. It also covers n=0 and T=0.

regions.title: Exclude fixed-horizon endpoint atoms from the actual input
regions.exposition: A coordinate hyperplane {t_i=T} has zero finite-product Lebesgue measure. Comap to the simplex and multiplication by any nonnegative density preserve that null set. The prefix pushforward law transfers this to the actual history observer on the strict guard. Actual exponential inputs are simultaneously positive almost surely, and the actual finite recurrence then gives strict increases between live records. If the nth event equals T, the entire finite history belongs to the strict guard at T+1. Applying the guarded nullity there avoids excluding the endpoint by definition. A countable intersection over positive n proves no event exactly at this fixed T. No intersection over all real T is taken.

regions.title: Close count interpretation, disjointness and full probability
regions.formula: N(T)=n\ \Longleftrightarrow\ C_n(T)\quad P\text{-a.s.},\qquad N(T)=\#\{j>0:T_j<T\}=\#\{j>0:T_j\le T\}.\qquad C_i\cap C_j=\varnothing\ (i\ne j),\quad P(\bigcup_n C_n)=1.
regions.exposition: On every raw C_n, the last time is at most T (initial time0 handles n=0), and survival makes the next time strictly greater than T: thus C_n⊆I_n. Conversely, on the common full event of positive clocks, fixed-T no-atoms and physical-time coverage, any covering interval has a live history with strictly increasing times and all positive-index times below T, and its residual wait survives to T. Hence I_n=C_n on that event for all n. The least covering index is unique, so N=n iff C_n and the preceding cardinality lemma applies. Raw C disjointness follows from C_n⊆I_n and monotonicity. Almost-sure coverage then makes their countable union have mass1.

regions.title: Assemble the sealed actual history/path law
regions.exposition: Keep the one actual Z and all original six assumptions. Its joint measurability gives each coordinate-measurable Z_T; combine this with H_n,N,Ψ,Γ,ρ measurability and prescribed path evaluation. The sets {N=n} and C_n agree almost surely, so their restricted measures agree. On C_n the whole paths Ψ(H_n) and Z_T agree pointwise. Substitution into the weighted joint pushforward and every nonnegative test identity gives the claimed actual law. The same almost-sure set equality transfers the mass formula ∫ρ=P(C_n) to P{N=n}. In particular the zero-event term retains terminal survival; it is not normalized to one for positive T.
